cohort: The cohort consisted of 231 preterm infants (69 with EOS) from May 2017 to October 2021.
finding: Maternal neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), and mean platelet volume (MPV) levels were found to be independent risk factors with good predictive value for early-onset sepsis (EOS) in preterm infants.
